title: Documented Hardship Rates on Compromise Measurement (Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery)
content:
Documented hardship on a debt in **Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery** sets a hardship rate when the lump sum of a compromise offer is measured.

**Rule.** When a waiver was denied on the debt in the last six calendar months and a request with a Financial Status Report was received in that period, the hardship-with-report rate of 90 percent applies. When a waiver was denied in that period without such a report, the plain hardship rate of 95 percent applies. Otherwise no hardship rate applies.

A denied waiver is a waiver decision on the debt with the outcome denied, dated by its decision date. A request with a report is any request on the debt recorded with a Financial Status Report attached. A period of so many calendar months counted back from today covers the dates from which fewer than that many whole calendar months have passed to today: on 20 October, the last six months include 21 April but not 20 April. The hardship rate is a percentage of the recovery remaining after the cost deduction; it acts on that one figure before the limit to the balance and the final rounding.

| Waiver denied in the period | Request with a report in the period | Hardship rate |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 90 percent |
| Yes | No | 95 percent |
| No | Either | None |

**Hypothetical case.** A figure of 4,900.00 USD after the cost deduction, with a waiver denied last month on a request that carried a report: 4,410.00 USD.
